The '''Chiss Poachers''' were a group of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] present in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CPB" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Chiss were active in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where they maintained a [[Chiss Hunter Settlement|settlement]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> Contrary to other hunting groups, such as the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Hunters, that paid the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the authorization to hunt creatures on Kashyyyk, the Chiss established themselves on the planet without requesting any authorization. The Chiss Poachers also had a [[Chiss Poachers' Base|base]] in the Kashyyyk system. The Chiss' vast financial holdings kept their supply lines running smoothly and their access to numerous independent shipyards keep their fighting vessels on constant patrol.<ref name="SWG:CPB" /> In space battles, Chiss pilots flew [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s, [[Ixiyen-class fast attack craft|''Ixiyen''-class fast attack crafts]]<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> and [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]]s.<ref name="SWG:FR" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Poachers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Chiss Poachers were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
